revisions.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Edit the provided old-wolf portrait. Keep the same clear Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime lineart and cel shading, the full-body gigantic natural northern WOLF anatomy, the impressive upright regal pose on the rock, camera, complete paws and tail, framing, northern woodland setting and lighting. This wolf must become unmistakably EXTREMELY OLD AND BATTLE-WORN, a distinct individual: Hrolf's wolf, the elderly father of Freki, NOT Freki himself. REPLACE THE FACE AND COAT AGE DETAILS: both eyes are normal dull amber, no blind/cloudy eye, REMOVE the three parallel vertical Freki scars from the forehead/eye entirely. Give him an old broader blunt wolf muzzle, heavily white-silver muzzle and cheek fur, sagging old jowls, heavy tired eyelids, deeply weathered calm amber gaze. The ears are slightly smaller-looking, worn and nicked in different places, not Freki's precise torn-ear pattern. His entire coat has substantially more age-silvering, especially nearly white eyebrow tufts, broad silver-white beard and throat, a faded grizzled ash-gray mane with a few rough uneven tufts, and faded gray-brown body fur. Add one short irregular old healed scar across the bridge of the nose, no fresh wound. The massive chest and forequarters retain their old strength, but the flanks and haunch subtly show lost muscle and age beneath the uneven coat. Let him raise his chin a little, radiating quiet dignity despite tired age. He must look ancient, weathered, gigantic and still regal, not young and glossy, not injured and collapsing. No horns, no jewelry, no collar, no armor, no magical effects. One wolf only. Output vertical 2:3, 1024x1536. Keep all paws and tail within frame.
